classification.classification_reason: The article is primarily about Tesla's autonomous vehicle, Cybercab, and its pre-order process.

content.title: Tesla Opens Cybercab Pre-Orders for Personal Use
content.caption: Tesla announced select customers can pre-order its autonomous Cybercab for personal use, with specific delivery and operating restrictions.

slides.heading: Tesla Opens Cybercab Pre-Orders for Personal Use
slides.text: Tesla announced select customers can pre-order its autonomous Cybercab for personal use, with specific delivery and operating restrictions.

slides.heading: Pre-Order Details
slides.text: Customers must accept delivery in Texas cities and operate within specific geofenced areas.

slides.heading: Monthly Fee
slides.text: Cybercab owners will need to pay $299 per month to operate their vehicle.
